_comment: Generated for Pterodactyl Panel. The installer downloads the interactive setup script.
name: EaglerXServer Standalone
author: EaglerXServer contributors

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eu
apk add --no-cache curl
mkdir -p /mnt/server
curl -fL --retry 3 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Cleint123/eaglersetup/main/eaglerweb/setup.sh -o /mnt/server/setup.sh
chmod +x /mnt/server/setup.sh
